# How to make an AI short film with Kling 4 from key stills

**A beat sheet and cast photos become GPT Image 2.5 stills, one 30-second Kling 4 take per beat, and a film cut like live action.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_7c4a6940fcd3.webp" alt="An approved key frame of a towering wave made of glowing screens over a night street turns into the Kling 4 shot as the wave crashes down." width="480"></p>

Make a cinematic short film, music video or story video with Kling 4 the way it works best: beat sheet, a cast and look reference, every key shot made as a still on GPT Image 2.5, then one 30-second Kling 4 reference-to-video take per beat from two to four stills and a short prompt, then cut the usable seconds like live-action takes. Includes the still prompt template ("Image 1 is the man to match exactly…"), the take prompt, dialogue scenes, a fix pass for faces and hands, costs and the varg calls. Use when someone wants a short film, music video, Halloween or holiday film, comedy sketch, trailer or narrative scene made with Kling 4 (kling_v4), asks how to get cinematic Kling 4 results, or says their Kling 4 output looks like AI slop. For prompt rules only use kling-4-prompting; for a single action montage use kling-4-action-montage.

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill kling-4-keyframe-film                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills kling-4-keyframe-film --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 60–90 s cinematic short film MP4 |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$7.05 per 30 s take at 1080p; plan 2–4 takes per beat |
| Uses | Kling 4, GPT Image 2.5, varg API, FFmpeg |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Make a 60-second Halloween comedy short with Kling 4 starring the two people in ./cast/, 21:9"
- "Plan a four-beat story: stills on GPT Image 2.5 first, then one 30-second Kling 4 take per beat, with a dialogue scene"
- "My Kling 4 short looks like AI slop. Rebuild it from key stills and cut the usable seconds like live-action takes"
